info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Term Deposit Framework Agreement API
info.description: The Term Deposit Framework Agreement API facilitates the retrieval of detailed information regarding term deposit agreements. This endpoint allows users to access specific framework agreements based on a unique identifier, providing critical insights into terms, conditions, and associated benefits. Financial institutions, advisors, and clients can utilize this API to review or verify agreement details seamlessly. By integrating this endpoint, developers can enhance applications that manage banking products, ensuring users are well-informed about their term deposit options.

get.summary: Retrieve Term Deposit Framework Agreement by ID
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific Term Deposit Framework Agreement using its unique identifier. This is useful for accessing essential information related to the agreement, such as terms, rates, and conditions.
